title: How to Recruit Qualified Staff in Nigeria in 48 Hours for Just ₦30,000
dek: Recruitment in Nigeria should not take three months and cost a fortune. Most businesses are not looking for a unicorn. They need a competent, reliable person who can do the job well and show up consistently. ATH Recruiters was built exactly for that, and it is accessible to any business in Nigeria regardless of size.

paragraphs: If you have used a traditional recruitment agency in Nigeria before, you probably remember the experience. You submit a brief and then wait. Weeks pass. You follow up. More waiting. Eventually a batch of CVs arrives, half of them irrelevant. You shortlist three people for interviews, one shows up, and you end up settling because the process has already taken too long. Meanwhile the role has been vacant for two months and the business has been managing without it.
That is not how recruitment has to work. And for businesses using ATH Recruiters, it does not work that way at all.

Recruitment starting price: ₦30,000*. Vetted candidates. 48-hour turnaround. View all plans and pricing on the ATH Recruiters plans page. *Starting price applies to select roles under specific plan tiers. See full plan details for scope and eligibility.

sections.heading: Why the Turnaround Is 48 Hours
paragraphs: The reason most recruitment agencies are slow is that they start sourcing candidates after you submit your brief. They post on job boards, collect applications, and then begin the process of sorting through hundreds of responses, most of which will not be suitable.

ATH Recruiters works differently. The talent pool is built and maintained continuously. Candidates are sourced, vetted, and kept ready before any brief comes in. When you tell us you need a customer service officer, a warehouse supervisor, a PA, or a driver, we are not starting from zero. We are matching your brief against people we already know, have already spoken to, and have already confirmed are available and qualified.
That is what makes 48 hours possible. Not a shortcut on quality. A different starting point entirely.

sections.heading: Industries We Recruit For
paragraphs: ATH Recruiters places candidates across virtually every major industry in Nigeria. Whether your business is in a traditionally difficult-to-staff sector or a high-volume hiring environment, we have the capacity to support it.

The roles we place range from entry-level and domestic staff to senior management, including operations leads, sales managers, HR officers, drivers, domestic staff, customer service teams, and executive-level appointments. If you need a person for a role that exists in a Nigerian business, we can find them.

sections.heading: The Three Plans
paragraphs: ATH Recruiters operates on three tiers, designed to match where your business is and what it needs.

list.t: For businesses that hire regularly. Unlimited candidate requests during your subscription period, 24 to 48 hour turnaround on standard roles. Starting from ₦30,000 for select roles.
For specific roles that need more careful matching. A structured search with a focus on skills verification and role fit. Typically two weeks for specialist placements.
For leadership roles, bulk hiring, and complex mandates. A fully managed process from brief to onboarding, with training included for your new team members.

paragraphs: Full plan details, scope, and current pricing are available at the ATH Recruiters plans page. If you are not sure which plan fits your situation, the easiest thing to do is reach out directly and we will advise you in under five minutes.

sections.heading: The Community Behind the Speed
paragraphs: The 48-hour turnaround is only possible because of what happens before you ever contact us. ATH Recruiters operates a private community of job seekers across Nigeria, and this community is not just a database of CVs. Members are actively trained, mentored, and prepared for the workplace through structured programmes run by our team.

This means the candidates you receive are not just available. They are ready. They have received guidance on workplace expectations, communication, professional conduct, and role-specific preparation depending on their target field. When you hire through ATH Recruiters, you are not taking a chance on someone who sent in a CV last week. You are meeting someone who has been part of a professional development community and is genuinely prepared to contribute from day one.

sections.text: The community is what separates ATH Recruiters from a job board. The training and mentorship is what separates our candidates from a random CV pile.

sections.heading: For Job Seekers: You Can Join the Community Too
paragraphs: If you are looking for work and want to be part of a community that actively prepares candidates for employment and connects them with genuine opportunities, ATH Recruiters accepts community members directly.

Members receive mentorship, access to training resources, and priority consideration for roles that come through the platform. Joining the community is free. The preparation, the network, and the opportunity are the value.
Visit the ATH Recruiters page to learn more about joining as a job seeker or to submit your profile to the community.

cta.title: Ready to Hire? We Can Start Today.
cta.text: Tell us the role you need filled, the location, and when you need them. We will come back to you with vetted candidates faster than any agency you have used before.

entries.q: How quickly can ATH Recruiters find staff in Nigeria?
entries.a: For standard roles under Plan A, ATH Recruiters can deliver shortlisted, vetted candidates within 24 to 48 hours of receiving a brief. This is possible because the talent pool is maintained continuously and candidates are already screened before a brief comes in, rather than sourced from scratch each time. Senior and specialist roles under Plan B and Plan C have longer timelines suited to the complexity of those searches.

entries.q: What industries does ATH Recruiters recruit for in Nigeria?
entries.a: ATH Recruiters recruits across retail and FMCG, hospitality and food service, real estate and property management, construction and engineering, technology and digital services, financial services and banking, healthcare, education and training, logistics and transport, manufacturing, professional services, and domestic and private household staffing.

entries.q: How much does it cost to use ATH Recruiters in Nigeria?
entries.a: Recruitment through ATH Recruiters starts from ₦30,000 for select roles under specific plan tiers. Pricing varies based on the plan, role type, and level of managed service required. Full plan details and pricing are available at the ATH Recruiters plans page.
